summary: T1 item 8: sim/CHARACTERIZATION.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated (sim/build_characterization_report.py), never hand-edited, and CI regenerates and diffs it on every push, so it cannot drift from the committed evidence. Item 8 asks for the aggregation artifact to exist and be current, not for every row to pass: this report currently reads FAIL on PSRR, MIXED on Startup, and marks most rows' underlying sim record STALE against the current design/netlist/*.spice. Those are item 5's gap, tracked there as unmet, not item 8's. Current limit and Thermal read PASS as of issue #139's re-run against DR-0005's ratified 62-95 mA / <= 346 mW rows (they read FAIL while the head record was still graded against the superseded 65-80 mA / <= 290 mW ones). Stability reads PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope (issue #276), with the wider DR-0001 full-matrix result shown alongside rather than driving the verdict. See signoff/README.md for the full reading. PSRR reads FAIL as of issue #289's re-run: sim/psrr-vs-freq and sim/psrr-vs-freq-50ma both fail the ratified > 50 dB @ 1 kHz row at 3 of 45 corners (worst 29.4268 dB at ff_125c_3.63v), superseding a stale PASS pair taken 2026-09-05. Root cause and why no sizing lever closes it: spec/decision-records/DR-0031. That is a real design gap, surfaced by the rollup rather than hidden by it -- which is the property item 8 grades; the gap itself is tracked as issue #302. Issue #279 / DR-0033's resistor-flavour swap moved the DUT netlist sha, so every record taken before it is stale against it: loop-stability, amp-openloop, amp-selfosc, psrr-dc, psrr-vs-freq, psrr-vs-freq-50ma, quiescent-current and dropout-vs-load are re-minted there and read fresh; current-limit is not (its record is hand-written), so Current limit and Thermal read STALE again, with the bench re-run and reproducing bit-identically. The PSRR verdict is unchanged by that swap -- the re-minted pair fails at the same three corners, marginally better at every one. Issue #294 / DR-0033's successor DR-0034 widened the pass device from 2 mm to 2.8 mm, which moves the DUT netlist sha again: loop-stability, dropout-vs-load, quiescent-current and current-limit are re-minted against the 2.8 mm device and read fresh (Current limit and Thermal read fresh for the first time since the row was hand-written), while the PSRR pair and psrr-dc's siblings go stale against it -- the PSRR verdict itself is unchanged and still FAIL per DR-0031. Stability still reads PASS against the DR-0018-ratified envelope, 630/630 at 48.65 deg / 11.21 dB; the wider DR-0001 window it is shown alongside degrades from 2974/4536 to 2790/4536, which is outside the ratified envelope and not what this row grades. Issue #304 re-mints sim/psrr-vs-freq alone against the 2.8 mm device (record 20260923-233113-1a8fcf7), so that row reads fresh again while psrr-vs-freq-50ma stays stale against it; the PSRR verdict is unchanged -- still FAIL at the same three corners, worst 29.4286 dB at ff_125c_3.63v -- and the harness-integrity checks (dc_vout_v, dc_iload_ma) now pass at all 45 corners, including the fs_125c_3.63v sub-ground state #304 characterised as a false convergence rather than a second solution. Issue #325 adds the missing vout-range half of that discriminator to sim/line-regulation and sim/load-regulation and re-mints both against the current (DR-0034, 2.8 mm) device: load-regulation reads PASS 81/81 and fresh; line-regulation reads FAIL and fresh, at 1 of 27 corners -- ff_125c_3.30v, 8.2345 mV/V at 1 mA and 8.23715 mV/V at 50 mA against the ratified < 5 mV/V row -- which also flips the Output row from PASS to FAIL, since line regulation is counted inside its +/-2% window. That verdict is not damage done by #325's wording change: the record it supersedes was taken 2026-09-05 against a pre-DR-0033/DR-0034 netlist and read STALE, and the failing corner plus the next-worst one (ff_125c, sf_125c at 2.91 mV/V) are exactly the corners DR-0031 root-causes to the soft-start FB-injection element's supply-dependent settled residual (112.5 nA/V, 33 mV/V at VOUT through Rtop = 300 kOhm) -- the defect tracked as issue #302, whose acceptance set names only the PSRR decks today. Both decks' harness-integrity checks, the new vout_* bounds included, PASS at every corner, so this is a regulation error and not a sub-ground root.
